**Free Training To Build Goodwill & Drop Tons Of Value \+ Extend Invitation To Offer On The Back**  
**![][image1]**

You can run a free training VERY SIMILAR to the exact offer that you have \- preselling on the exact strategies that you’re paid opportunity is going to be solving. 

Put Together Training you’re going to run live \- use this as an anchor post throughout promo or even just to inject a couple of quick sales when you’d like

- PPT Training Was on the 4 pillars to build you first or next 100k business (same things we dived deeper into over 8 weeks)   
- Thami training is on 5 strategies (all covered inside our training)  
- JV With James \- 10k ft overview of the model that he used   
- Preictable profits \- ROI Checklist   
- This 8-week cashflow class \- The Ingredients to a profitable offer 

The 3 main nuances we have to use to effectively leverage this strategy: 

1. Free Training Is 10k ft overview of your process, model, strategy anchor for convo about offer \= step by step \- training \- the next thing needed etc 

2. Raw info tactics, high value thing to help them get to XYZ \- anchor for sales / convos \= support implementation / coaching or proximity 

3. X Steps Out Of X (can kinda use this will both of the above) don’t intentionally create problems but naturally look at what you’re giving someone on the free training & use the NEXT thing as the angle to get them to chat about offer 

Also give you the scope to pull on resources or doc you already have to put together the training you’re running for free (less work on your part) 

Works well because naturally, you’ll have a bit more volume attending live because it’s a “free thing” 

The goal would be to actually give them a tangible thing on the free training \- so they could actually go implement something afterward (makes working with you even more appealing / reinforces proof of concept & that you know your shit) 

**Power Of This (Also, our Course is Free right now in our free group here [https\://www\.skool.com/group-juice/about](https://www.skool.com/group-juice/about) )**

- Running the training in itself is PRESELLING your offer \- especially if you can embed wins/results into the strategy

- It’s a leveraged thing that you can continue to push traffic to \- even after the live for weeks/months \- depending on how long you’re running a promo or however long you want to keep it inside the group 

- The Sales on the back end are usually VERY LOW pressure \- They’ve spent X amount of time with you already & lit up about the fact that you’re dropping nuggets on them \- Getting them into Full-offer is a breeze

- Can work really well to kick off the momentum of a full-promo cycle. Snag a few sales right out of the gate & it makes all the other components spicier  
  - Limited Availability/proof of concept because they’ll see other people tipping in or even interested to join 

- Step Further Away from DM \- Resuming your regular programming posting content & running promo / In dm people ask questions about X \- you can tag them on the training & have them circle back with you after

**Pre-Value** 

- Give yourself 3 \- 10 days to build up your curiosity about your upcoming “free training”  
- Get Event Scheduled Inside group so you can invite everyone to attend   
- Tap Content everywhere you can about the upcoming training   
  - Profile, Group, Stories, Content & Emails  
      
    - Tackle portions of the training you’re going to be doing / cycle content / outcome

- Could lean into SHORTER “Purple Posts” as they’ll usually get more engagement/eyeballs and that’s exactly what you want \- To feed the live

- The ultimate goal is to get as many people as you can to come to hang with you on the free training, spend some time with you and stack your convo pipeline 

**Post Training** 

If you had a few converts into offers on the back end of live \- Can lean heavily into this. 

Follow Up With **EVERYONE** who joined you \- even if they didn’t say “hey i want the offer” 

**Feed The Training \-** 

- Regular content strategy/rotation but mixing in a CTA to catch a free training you just did on X to help the Accomplish X or without X 

- Use this as “Bait” inside your group \- so you can talk about it externally & even inside the group 

- Embed takeaways from those who attended the training & results from it 

**Can Look at the live as an “anchor post” \- That’ll:** 

- Build goodwill   
- Handle Certain objections   
- Presell for you 

---

**Deciding On What You’re Covering:**

* Work back wards from your offer / the thing you’re selling 

  * Who needs the offer   
  * What do they need to have prior   
  * What do they need to understand   
  * Who currently has the problem that your free training will fix   
  * What are they actively doing now 

The more ammo we can come up with & the more angles that we can play on the front to create demand for the free training the better off we’re going to be 

**Pick a date / deadline you’re going to run this free training (the longer out the better if you havent done it before)** 

- Start hitting as many content angles as possible with the sole goal of getting people to come hang out with you on this free thing 

**Run The Free Training** 

-  Could be a live in a group, could be a group zoom session 

  - Go into it with the goal over simply giving good info, a tactic, a tip or helping someone achieve what you’re showing them

  - Mix in invitations for folks to chat with you with an offer throughout the training 

**Post Free Training:** 

- Start covnos with every person that joined you on the free training 

- If good fits, move them towards getting your offer in their hands 

**Content Refeed:** 

- Leverage your content to resend people back through the free high valued thing to keep giving value to your audience.. Stack your convos with warmer people & send offers 

**Lean heavy on this for the 1st half of your promotion**

1\. All your content, from as many different angles, lenses & positions create a net of attention around your  free thing 

2\. You leverage everyone who’s watched, joined, asked for the free training to build your pipeline of folks to follow up with & chat about your offers 

**2nd Half:** 

Leaning more into direct offer posts, deadlines, reasons for people to act now, price increases, people jumping in etc 

Follow up and make offers unapologetically

Help some folks and increase your income
